from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document with its title and identified cause of action."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) identified in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
